ideas.idea: The yacht is 82 metres in length with a 12.8-metre beam and approximately 2,250 gross tonnage.

Design employs clean lines, harmonious proportions, sculpted surfaces and three-dimensional elements to achieve strong visual identity without compromising balance, with intent to remain visually relevant over time.

Owner's suite positioned forward on upper deck for privacy and horizon views; interior circulation uses side passage overlooking exterior rather than central corridor to maintain visual connection with sea.
Bridge deck dedicated entirely to wellness amenities rather than traditional lounge, with gym, sauna, massage area, shower and pool. Stern features extensive beach club space.

Features include fully operational touch-and-go helipad, lift connecting all decks to sundeck, 144-square-metre beach club with fold-down side terraces, extensive tender and water toy storage with garage accommodating two 10-metre tenders plus option for third seven-metre crew tender, and main deck pool with transparent bottom filtering light into beach club below.
Bridge deck aft dedicated to comprehensive wellness facilities including gym, sauna, massage area, shower and pool rather than traditional social spaces.
Side passage overlooking exterior provides constant visual connection with sea; main deck pool has transparent bottom to filter natural light into beach club below.
Seven cabins accommodate 12 guests with crew quarters for 21 personnel.

Construction in steel and aluminium with naval architecture developed in-house by shipyard. Power from two 2,240 kW engines with maximum speed of 17 knots and cruising speed of 14 knots; range approximately 6,200 nautical miles at 12 knots. Equipped with two pairs of non-retractable stabiliser fins including zero-speed stabilisation.
